title: Hhune Mausoleum
html:
The Hhune Mausoleum is a Location within the Lower City in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be accessed through the Graveyard of the Lower City. The aboveground entrance is on the northern side of the mortuary.

Access

The mausoleum can be accessed through the Lower City's Graveyard, on the northern side beside the mortuary at X: 17 Y: 41. It requires either  Hhune Mausoleum Key which can be found in the Knights of the Shield Hideout, in a Mahogany Wardrobe at X: -744 Y: 537 or  DC 10 Sleight of Hand Check to open the gate.

Overview

The mausoleum contains one sarcophagus and several hidden ( DC 15 Perception Check) tripwire traps. A hidden ( DC 20 Perception Check) cracked tile east of the sarcophagus contains the  Hhune Mausoleum Iron Key.

Opening the sarcophagus requires passing a  DC 15 Strength Check check. Inside the sarcophagus is the  Hhune Mausoleum Golden Key and a note,  THE LEGACY OF HHUNE, which states: "KNEEL WITH THE WEIGHT OF ALL YOU VALUE AT HIS FEET, AND HE WILL REVEAL HIMSELF."

At the foot of the sarcophagus between two columns, a tile is highlighted on a Perception check. If party members stand on it with a combined inventory weight of at least 400 kg (800 lbs), a hidden door opens along the southeastern wall of the mausoleum.

A crumbling wall on the west end can be destroyed to access the Gorion Mausoleum.

Hidden room

Inside the hidden room is a Knights of the Shield statue and a  Journal written by one of the members of the Knights. In the journal, the writer mentions being introduced to the  Emperor, who they believed would be a "boon" to the Knights.

Beneath the statue is a gilded chest which can be unlocked with the Hhune Mausoleum Golden Key, containing random valuables. Beside it is a heavy chest which can be opened with the Hhune Mausoleum Iron Key, containing more random valuables. The shelves contain various silver valuables.
